 Dated this the 18th day of July, 2025
 Judgment
The writ petition is filed to quash Ext.P15 order passed by the 2nd respondent rejecting the petitioner's application for renewal of trade license.

2. Heard; the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the respondents.
3.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that, during the pendency of the writ petition, the petitioner has submitted Ext.P16 statutory appeal along with a stay application before the Panchayat Committee.
Ext.P17 is the receipt evidencing the filing of the appeal.

The petitioner would be satisfied, if the Panchayat Committee is directed to consider the appeal expeditiously and direct the respondents to permit the petitioner to operate the service villa, until a decision is taken on the appeal.
I find the above submission to be reasonable and justifiable.

On a consideration of the facts and the materials on record, especially that Ext.P16 appeal is pending consideration before the Panchayat Committee from 11.07.2025, without expressing anything on the merits of the appeal and the prayer for an interim order, I dispose of the writ petition, by directing the Panchayat Committee of the 1st respondent - Panchayat to consider and dispose of Ext.P16 appeal, in accordance with law and as expeditiously as possible, at any rate,
within one month from the date of production of a copy of the judgment, after affording the petitioner an opportunity of being heard.
Until such time the orders are passed on the appeal, the petitioner shall be permitted to operate the service villa on the same terms and conditions mentioned in Exts.P3 to P5 trade licenses.
The writ petition is ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
C.S.DIAS, JUDGE SCB.18.07.25.
